newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LYNAGH INJURY WORRIES EASE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LYNAGH INJURY WORRIES EASE.

text.p: Australia's World Cup captain Michael Lynagh has not dislocated his shoulder after all.
His English club Saracens thought the fly-half could be out of action for up to three months after he was injured in Sunday's match against Wasps.
But Saracens coach Mark Evans said on Monday: "It appears that Michael's shoulder injury is not as bad as originally feared.
"Michael saw a specialist this morning and was happy to hear that the shoulder was not dislocated.
"It is hoped now that, after intensive physio, Michael should be back playing in about three weeks' time."
